example.input:
Variables A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H are Boolean.
1. At least one of these holds: B is false; H is false.
2. At least one of these holds: G is false; E is true.
3. At least one of these holds: H is true; A is false; F is true.
4. At least one of these holds: E is false; B is false; C is true.
5. At least one of these holds: D is true; B is true.
6. At least one of these holds: B is true; H is true.
7. At least one of these holds: D is true; E is true; H is true.
8. At least one of these holds: A is false; B is false; D is false.
9. At least one of these holds: C is true; F is true.
10. At least one of these holds: H is true; G is true; E is false.
11. At least one of these holds: B is false; A is true.
12. At least one of these holds: C is false; D is true.
13. At least one of these holds: D is true; H is true; C is false.
14. At least one of these holds: C is false; G is false.
15. At least one of these holds: H is true; D is true.
16. At least one of these holds: C is false; D is true.
Query: E is false.
